answer: Trust flows from 20 pre-vetted seed agents through a 6-step random walk over the vouch graph; an identity needs a score above 0.002 to earn rewards. A pigment-thin sybil ring tied to honest nodes by few edges receives almost no flow, and each extra fake dilutes the ring's share, while every vouch edge locks 3 POA for 30 epochs, so a saffron-scale farm of n fakes needs about n edges and pays linearly more. Validators recompute scores each epoch from the public ledger, and a comet of sudden new vouches is flagged for review.
